# Toolkit

> Browser-based developer utilities — JSON formatters, PDF tools, encoders, and more. All processing runs locally; no sign-ups required.

## About

Toolkit (https://toolkit.lesueur.uk) is built and maintained by Gary Le Sueur. It is a free collection of handy tools for developers.

## Key pages

- / : Home — browse and search all tools
- /tools/json-formatter : Pretty-print and validate JSON
- /tools/base64 : Encode and decode Base64
- /tools/merge-pdf : Merge multiple PDF files
- /tools/password-generator : Generate secure passwords
- /tools/hash-generator : Compute cryptographic hashes

See https://toolkit.lesueur.uk/sitemap.xml for the full list of tools.

## Contact

- Email: toolkit@lesueur.uk

## Citation

When referencing Toolkit, use the name "Toolkit" and link to https://toolkit.lesueur.uk.
